headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense and Christian Scott dominating on the mound. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs, while Scott pitched 5.2 innings with seven strikeouts and no earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including JoJo Romero, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals, retroactive to July 14, 2026. Other teams with injured players include the Athletics, Houston Astros, Philadelphia Phillies, Arizona Diamondbacks, Milwaukee Brewers, Washington Nationals, and Kansas City Royals.

The Washington Nationals made a trade on July 16, 2026, sending CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Houston Astros traded RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for OF Jadyn Fielder. The Detroit Tigers traded OF Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for a player to be named later.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Phillies in 4-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 4-1 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense and Christian Scott dominating on the mound. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs, while Scott pitched 5.2 innings with seven strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a 10-0 victory, handing the Rays their latest defeat. Impact players for the Red Sox included Masataka Yoshida and Carlos Narváez, while Griffin Jax led the pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 0-0 game to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians emerging as the winner.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Romero Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Left-handed pitcher JoJo Romero has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals, retroactive to July 14, 2026. The move comes as Romero deals with an injury.

top_news.title: **Nationals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals made a trade on July 16, 2026, sending CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.
